symptom_id.description: The unique symptom ID being evaluated, for example SYM-023.

severity.description: How severe the issue is for this symptom. 0 means no issue found. 1 minor issue. 2 meaningful issue. 3 serious issue. 4 critical issue. 5 catastrophic issue.

confidence.description: How confident the reviewer is in the severity judgment based on available evidence.

scope.description: How far the issue reaches. Local affects one narrow area. Cross_cutting affects multiple files or one concern across several places. Systemic affects architecture, core patterns, or the whole system.

summary.description: A short plain-language statement of the finding for this symptom.

rationale.description: Why this severity and scope were chosen, tying the evidence back to the symptom definition.
